use: A section of the camp wall: drawn along the timber-walled camps' wall cells, instanced, in place of the code-built breastwork.

generator.prompt: A straight section of a Roman army camp palisade, about two and a half metres long and two metres high: one tight row of upright split oak stakes with sharpened points, a little uneven in height, bound with withies to two horizontal rails behind them, their feet set in a low bank of cut turf. Weathered grey-brown timber. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side.
